program:
PARAMS = {
    "W_in":  (2.0, 0.6, 8.0),     # diff pair W [um]
    "L_in":  (0.15, 0.15, 0.4),   # diff pair L
    "W_ld":  (0.8, 0.42, 3.0),    # PMOS diode/mirror load W (L=0.15)
    "I_tail": (6e-6, 2e-6, 10e-6),# preamp tail current (set by mirror ratio)
    "I_2":   (8e-6, 3e-6, 12e-6), # CS stage current (mirror ratio)
    "W_b":   (2.0, 0.8, 6.0),     # reference diode W
    "L_b":   (1.0, 0.5, 2.0),     # bias mirror L
    "W_i1p": (1.5, 0.42, 4.0),    # inverter-1 PMOS W (sets trip ~0.7 V)
    "W_i2p": (3.0, 1.0, 10.0),    # inverter-2 PMOS W (drives CL)
}

def _vgs_for(lut, dev, W, L, Id, vds, vsb=0.0):
    lo, hi = 0.1, 1.8
    for _ in range(40):
        mid = 0.5 * (lo + hi)
        if lut.op(dev, W, L, mid, vds, vsb)["Id"] < Id:
            lo = mid
        else:
            hi = mid
    return 0.5 * (lo + hi)

def design(p, lut, spec):
    vod = spec.get("vod", 0.01)
    cl = spec.get("cl", 50e-15)
    iref = spec.get("iref", 5e-6)
    vdd = 1.8

    # current budget: total (incl. IREF) under ~20.5 uA
    itail, i2 = p["I_tail"], p["I_2"]
    avail = 20.5e-6 - iref
    if itail + i2 > avail:
        s = max(avail, 2e-6) / (itail + i2)
        itail, i2 = itail * s, i2 * s
    Lb, Wb = p["L_b"], p["W_b"]
    Wt = max(0.42, Wb * itail / iref)
    Wsk = max(0.42, Wb * i2 / iref)

    Lp = 0.15
    Wld = p["W_ld"]
    Wcs = max(0.42, Wld * i2 / (itail / 2))   # CS replicates diode load -> balanced at d1 level

    n = Netlist("vinp vinn vout vdd vss ibias")
    # bias
    n.M("MB", "ibias", "ibias", "vss", "vss", "nfet", Wb, Lb)
    n.M("MT", "tail", "ibias", "vss", "vss", "nfet", Wt, Lb)
    # preamp: vinn on diode side, o1 at vinp device -> o1 falls when vinp rises
    n.M("M1", "d1", "vinn", "tail", "vss", "nfet", p["W_in"], p["L_in"])
    n.M("M2", "o1", "vinp", "tail", "vss", "nfet", p["W_in"], p["L_in"])
    n.M("M3", "d1", "d1", "vdd", "vdd", "pfet", Wld, Lp)
    n.M("M4", "o1", "d1", "vdd", "vdd", "pfet", Wld, Lp)
    # CS gain stage: o2 rises when vinp rises
    n.M("M5", "o2", "o1", "vdd", "vdd", "pfet", Wcs, Lp)
    n.M("M6", "o2", "ibias", "vss", "vss", "nfet", Wsk, Lb)
    # inverter 1
    n.M("M7", "o3", "o2", "vss", "vss", "nfet", 0.42, 0.15)
    n.M("M8", "o3", "o2", "vdd", "vdd", "pfet", p["W_i1p"], 0.15)
    # inverter 2 -> vout (HIGH when vinp > vinn)
    Wi2n = max(0.42, p["W_i2p"] / 3.0)
    n.M("M9", "vout", "o3", "vss", "vss", "nfet", Wi2n, 0.15)
    n.M("M10", "vout", "o3", "vdd", "vdd", "pfet", p["W_i2p"], 0.15)

    # first-order predictions
    vcm = 0.9
    vsg_ld = _vgs_for(lut, "p", Wld, Lp, itail / 2, 1.0)
    vd1 = vdd - vsg_ld
    vgs_in = _vgs_for(lut, "n", p["W_in"], p["L_in"], itail / 2, max(0.1, vd1 - 0.35), 0.35)
    vtail = vcm - vgs_in
    opi = lut.op("n", p["W_in"], p["L_in"], vgs_in, max(0.1, vd1 - vtail), max(0.0, vtail))
    opl = lut.op("p", Wld, Lp, vsg_ld, vsg_ld)
    opc = lut.op("p", Wcs, Lp, vsg_ld, vsg_ld)
    gm1 = opi["gm"]
    g1 = opi["gds"] + opl["gds"]
    A1 = gm1 / max(g1, 1e-9)
    C1 = opc["cgg"] + 1.0e-15 * (Wld + p["W_in"]) + 1e-15
    tau1 = C1 / max(g1, 1e-9)
    v1 = A1 * vod
    t1 = 0.69 * tau1
    gm2 = opc["gm"]
    dI2 = min(i2, gm2 * v1)
    C2 = 1.0e-15 * (Wcs + p["W_i1p"] + 0.42 + Wsk * 0.5) + 1e-15
    t2 = C2 * 0.85 / max(dI2, 1e-9)
    i_inv = 300e-6 * Wi2n
    t3 = 1.5e-15 * (Wi2n + p["W_i2p"]) * 0.9 / 150e-6 + cl * 0.9 / i_inv
    tpd = t1 + t2 + t3
    power = vdd * (iref + itail + i2)

    return n, {"tpd": tpd, "power": power, "offset": 0.1 / max(A1 * 8.0, 1.0),
               "polarity_ok": 1}
